client.name: Clash
changes: The MSI Cup will be taking place on Summoner's Rift this patch.
Tournament Dates: July 18 and 19, 2026 (~ 4 - 7 PM Local Time, varies by region).

client.name: Parental Controls
changes: Riot is rolling out optional Parent Permissions to give parents more visibility and control over their child's social interactions in game. Parents can access parental controls by connecting a parent's email address via account control page, where they can limit text and voice chat, block friend requests, and view the social panel friends list. These controls are meant to provide parents with the tools to protect their child's safety.

client.name: Ranked
changes: Ranked Season 2 will end local server time at midnight 23:59 on July 28, 2026, which is the last day of patch 26.14. Several hours later, we'll roll over into patch 26.15, which marks the start of Season 3 at 12:00pm noon, July 29, 2026, local server time.

Similar to previous mid-year season transitions, Ranked Solo and Flex queues will be disabled during the down time. Shard transfer services will also be disabled to make sure rewards are properly calculated.
We don't expect any disruptions to your LP / Ranked progression, but the Victorious Ranked mission for 15 ranked games won will be refreshed when the new season starts.

client.name: T1 2025 Worlds Winners
changes: In honor of League's first three-peat world champions, the T1 Worlds Winner skins will follow a slightly different release approach. The Signature Bundles will include the skin, signature icon and border, ward skin, and Elite chroma. As a special bonus, each bundle will also include an exclusive emote inspired by the pros and the skin they helped design. The Worlds Winner Megabundle will include all Signature Bundles, and three megabundle exclusive items: Golden Team Icon, T1 2025 Worlds Winner Lobby Banner, and the "Three-peat, 1 Dynasty" Title. All bundles will be available for purchase for two patches, going away at the start of Patch 26.16.

All skins will also be individually purchasable with RP. T1 Ambessa, Xin Zhao, Galio, Yunara, and Seraphine will cost 1350 RP. The MVP skin this year, MVP T1 Miss Fortune, will also be individually purchasable for 1820 RP. Individual skins will be available in the Shop until the start of patch 26.23.

Once MVP T1 Miss Fortune leaves the Shop, she will be entered into the Mythic Shop pool in the first patch of 2027. She will have a chance to appear in the rotating or featured section, and she will be priced at 200 Mythic Essence. Acquiring MVP T1 Miss Fortune from the Mythic Shop will not include her Signature Icon or Border. The other Epic skins will leave the store and enter the Loot pool starting with the first patch of 2027.

In addition to the Elite chromas, there will also be 5 standard chromas available for purchase. The Ruby chroma will be a chroma bundle exclusive, and the others will be available for individual purchase.

Last, but certainly not least, swing by the Mythic Shop to snag the "Together as 1" Nexus Finisher for 250 Mythic Essence. It will be in the Featured section for two patches, leaving at the start of Patch 26.16.
Riot will share a portion of proceeds with LoL esports teams.

game.name: Buffs
changes: Trimmed redundant buffs that repeat information already clearly communicated elsewhere in the UI or gameplay state (e.g. role quest progress and other obvious state changes).
Moved most item buffs with durations into the inventory on the item itself.
Reduced buff bar clutter from lower-impact system, map and item effects that don't meaningfully change player decision-making.
Removed display of very short-duration debuffs and effects (˜0.25s), including things like minor slows from Honeyfruit pickups.

game.name: Mute
changes: Bug Fix: Deafen and self-mute functionality can now only be toggled once every 60 seconds to prevent spam and disruptive one-way communication.

game.name: Remake
changes: Bug Fix: Remake votes will now begin automatically when they are eligible rather than requiring a player to type /remake in chat. Chat context now explains which player triggered the remake vote and why.
